book.name: LUKASI
book.title: NHALU GHWA MAHA PAGHUTYEKITWE NA LUKASI

content: Yesu kagunlamiha mundu yumo
Linjubha limo lya Kupumulila Yesu kakighenda kulyegha hilyo ku lubhagha lwa yumoo ywa kilongohi ghwa Akaafalisayo, na bhandu bhaakibhegha apwo bhangunhingukiha.
Bahala pala mu ulongolo ghwake kakibhegha mundu ywakabheghite na utamwa wa kutupa mmili.
Yesu kakiakonya bhala Akaafalisayo na ahunda bha malaghilo, “Patughatughila malaghilo, bhuli ghangututegheka ebu ng'obhe kualamiha bhandu Mulinjubha lya Kupumulila?”
Peni bhombe bhakitama nuu. Habhu Yesu kakinkamula kibhoko yula ntamwa na kakinlamiha, na kakintegheka kaghende ukaya kwake.
Mbole Yesu kakiakonya bhombe, “Handa yumoo ywenu kangabheghite na mwana ebu likambako lya senga ghwakachumbukilite mu kilibha Linjubha lya Kupumulila, bhuli, mangannekite kya nga kummuha?”
Na bhandu abho bhakihotola ng'obhe kunnyanga.
Utekulo na kuakingama ahenja
Yesu pakabhonite bhala ahenja bhaalalikitwe anguhaghula hiteho hya kuulongolo pauhokamilo lisaa lya mulyo, ndo kakiaghombela ndambulo ayi.
“Mundu pakaghulalika ku chekwa ya kutolana, ghukotoke kutama pa kiteho kya kuulongolo, kiyaha pangi kanlalika mundu yungi ywa kuhokamilwa kupitingana kwa ghwenga,
handa pantenda naha yula ywakaalalikite mwenga maabhili, katahika na kughughombela, ‘Ghunlekele mundu ayu katame mu kiteho kyako.’ Ndo kwa honi yaghukwiliha kutama ku kiteho kya unyuma.

Mbole yake handa paghulalikwa, ghutame kukiteho kya unyuma ngati yula nkolakaya ghwako pakaghubhona katahika na kukughombela, ‘Ghanja ghwangu, ghuhike ghutame mung'ebhu ya akulu paulongolo.’ Apwo ndo ghwakwehwa mu ulongolo ghwa ahenja ayako bhoha.
Kiyaha mundu ywoheli ywakalikweha kaahuluhwa, na ywakalihuluha kaakwehwa.”

Mbole Yesu kakinng'ombela yula ywakaalalikite, “Paghutendekeha chekwa ya hilyo ya pamuhi ebu ya makimuhi, ghukotoke kualalikiha aghanja bhako ebhu alongo bhako bhaabheghite na utopelo ghweka chabhe. Handa paghutenda habhu na bhene bhaghukulalika kwabhe, na ghwenga ghwabhuyihilwa kila kighuatendilite na ghwamokola lilumbo lyako kala.
Kihyengo kyake handa paghutenda chekwa, ghubhalalike akapukwa, bhanautebhalo na bhangabhona,
na ghwenga ghwaanonelwa kiyaha abho abhegha nakyo ng'obhe kya kughubhuyihila. Chapanga kaghupegha lilumbo lyako pala bhandu bhaaghatughila ghala ghakaghapala Chapanga paahyuka.”
Ndambulo ya chekwa ngulu
Hino yumoo ywa bhala bhandu ywakatamite papamu na Yesu pakayihwite agha kaking'ombela Yesu, “Kanonelwa mundu yula ywakapalakulyegha mumulyo ghwa Ghubhutwa ghwa Chapanga!”
Yesu kakiaghombela bhombe, “Mundu yumu kakibhegha mu kutendekeha chekwa ngulu, kakialalika bhandu atangalo.
Lisaa lya chekwa palihikite kakialaghila abhandwa bhake bhakaaghombele bhala bhakaalalikite, ‘Nhike, kiyaha kila kilibhi kibha kala.’

Peni bhoha yumu mbole ya yungi bhakiyanda kulongela kinlemikihite kuhika muchekwa. Ghwa ulongohi kakilongela, ‘Hemela nng'unda, na yingwiliha ng'ende kughubhona, chonde ketekete nughukuyupa ghunekekehe.’
Mundu yungi kakilongela, ‘Hemela likambako lya senga mbinda libhoko yimo bha kukanda lutupi, hinaa nungughenda kubhayighihila kukanda, chonde ketekete nughukuyupa ghunekekehe’
Na mundu yungi kakilongela, ‘Ndolela nndala hinu hinu, habhu ndaahika kata.’

Yula nbhandwa kakibhuya, na kakinng'ombela bambo ghwake mihalo yila. Ndo yula nkola kaya kakikalala, kakinlaghila yula ndumindumi pakilongela, ‘Ghughende kya kuyumbatika mu njila na mu hijiji hyoha, ghubhayeghe apa makapukwa, angwabhengwabhe, bhangalola na atebhaho bhangi.’
Mbole yula nbhandwa kakibhuya na pakilongela, ‘Bambo, ghala ghunaghilite nighatenda kala, peni yikali yihighala ng'ebu mu ludamu.’
Ndo yula Bambo kaking'ombela nbhandwa bhake, ‘Ghughende munjila na hijiji hibheghite panje ya kitami na ghubhakwilikihe bhandu bhayingile ili lubhigho lwangu kimeme.
Peni ninguaghombela, kahone hata yumu ywa bhala bhanialalikite ywaapaha hilyo hya Chekwa ya nenga.’ ”
Utahuko ghwa kubhegha nhundwa
Lumati lukulu lwa bhandu lukibhegha lungulongohana na Yesu, naywo kakikilibhuka na kakilighombela,

“Mundu ywohele ywakahika kwa nenga, kaahotola ng'obhe kubhegha nhundwa ghwangu handa katambala ng'obhe nenga kupitingana tate ghwake, ebu ma ghake, ebu nndala ghwake na bhana bhake, ebu alongo bhake, ebu ahacha bhake, ena, na hata ubhumi ghwake mweni.
Ywohele yunakutola ng'obhe lupingika lwake na kundughila nenga kaabhegha nhundwa bhangu kata.
Nleki huti nubhaghombele, ndo ghani mumwenga, mwene handa kapala kuchenga nnala, katatama ng'obhe pahi na kuyibhalanga utahuko ghwake kaghubhone kukita kabha na ngalabha hya kukiyomolela?
Hela bhubho, mbole ya kuchenga kitamilo kya maganga na kulepelwa kuhotola kughuchenga nnala, bhandu bhoha bhaamona bhaayanda kunheka,
paalongela, ‘Mundu ayu kakiyanda kuchenga, peni kakihotola ng'obhe kuyomola.’

Ebu ndo Mutwa ywoki ywakabhuka kughenda ku mikoha kututana na mutwa yungi, na kakotoke kuhwacha huti kahotola kututana mikoha na kukita handa kabhegha na machonda mbinda libhoko elufu kaahotola kuntuta yula ywakahika na machonda mbinda mabhoko ibhili elufu?
Handa kaabhona katalepelwa, katabhalaghila atangatila bhake aghende kukongana na yula mutwa yungi, ayupe mihilo ya uhihimilo, pala yula mutwa yungi pakakali kutali.
Ubhwabhu abhu, kahone na yumu mu mwenga kaahotola kubha nhundwa ghwangu handa kataleka ng'obhe hyoha hyakabheghite naywo.”
Mwinyu ghuululukite
“Mwinyu ndo kilibhi kya maha, peni handa mwinyu paghululuka, kahone kya kutendelwa ngati yibhe kangi mwinyu.
Ghwanogha ng'obhe kwa lutupi ebu kwa mbosela, ngati ghwataghwa hela. Yunamakutu gha kuyihwa, kakayihwe.”
